replication.target_description: Hostler and Persson direct replication, project Vollmann_EurJournPersonality_2011_x3KP / k5z, OSF a8eg9: actor effect of optimism on perceived stress in an Actor–Partner Interdependence Model constrained across gender for interchangeable heterosexual romantic dyads.

es.location: Report p. 2, Replication result, focal actor effect in constrained interchangeable-dyad APIM
es.quote:
The actor
effect of optimism on perceived stress was b = -0.298, z= -9.529, p<.001 ... The b reported here is the unstandardized path coefficient, and the p-value is from a
z-test used by MPlus to test the null hypothesis of a path coefficient of 0.
